nodes.name: Theorem 5.1: Existence uniqueness geometric ergodicity
nodes.statement:
Suppose that Assumptions
4.1,
4.2,
4.3,
and
4.4
hold.
	
Then the projected Markov chain
$(\bar H^{(t)})_{t\ge0}$
with transition kernel $K$:
	\begin{enumerate}
		
		\item admits a unique invariant probability measure
		$\mu$;
		
		\item converges to $\mu$ from every initial condition;
		
		\item converges geometrically in the Wasserstein metric.
		
	\end{enumerate}

nodes.name: Proposition 5.2: Stationary second-moment identity
nodes.statement:
Suppose that Assumptions
4.1,
4.2,
4.3,
and
4.4
hold.	
	Then	
	\[
	\boxed{
		\mathbb E_\mu
		\!\left[
		\|\bar H\|_F^2
		\right]
		=
		\mathbb E_\mu
		\!\left[
		\|\Delta(\bar H)\|_F^2
		\right]
		+
		\sigma^2 (N-1)d.
	}
	\]

nodes.name: Lemma 5.3: Contractive variance estimate
nodes.statement:
Suppose that Assumptions
4.1,
4.2,
4.3,
and
4.4
hold.
	
	Then
	
	\[
	\boxed{
		\mathbb E_\mu
		\!\left[
		\|\Delta(\bar H)\|_F^2
		\right]
		\le
		\alpha^2
		\,
		\mathbb E_\mu
		\!\left[
		\|\bar H\|_F^2
		\right].
	}
	\]

nodes.name: Theorem 5.4: Persistence of projected variance
nodes.statement:
Suppose that Assumptions
4.1,
4.2,
4.3,
and
4.4
hold. Then the unique invariant probability measure satisfies
	
	\[
	\boxed{
		\mathbb E_\mu
		\!\left[
		\|\bar H\|_F^2
		\right]
		\ge
		\frac{\sigma^2 (N-1)d}
		{1-\alpha^2}
		>0.
	}
	\]
	
	Consequently, the projected hidden representations possess a strictly
	positive stationary variance.

nodes.name: Lemma 3.3: Spectral-gap inequality
nodes.statement:
For every
	$H\in\mathbb R^{N\times d}$,
	
	\[
	\mathcal E(H)
	\ge
	\frac{\lambda_2(L)}{m}
	\,
	\|\bar H\|_F^2.
	\]

nodes.name: Theorem 5.6: Positive lower bound for stationary Dirichlet energy Escape from oversmoothing
nodes.statement:
Suppose that Assumptions
4.1,
4.2,
4.3,
and
4.4
hold.	
	Let	
	\[
	(H^{(t)})_{t\ge0}
	\]
	denote the noisy recurrent graph neural network defined in
	Section~4.
	Then	
\[
\boxed{
	\lim_{t\rightarrow\infty}
	\mathbb E
	\!\left[
	\mathcal E(H^{(t)})
	\right]
	=
	\mathbb E_\mu
	\!\left[
	\mathcal E(\bar H)
	\right]
	\ge
	\frac{\lambda_2(L)}{m}
	\,
	\frac{\sigma^2(N-1)d}
	{1-\alpha^2}
	>0.
}
\]
	Consequently, the noisy recurrent graph neural network escapes
	oversmoothing in the sense of
	Definition~3.3.
